description: General Electric Company operates as GE Aerospace, a global aerospace leader with the industry's largest and growing commercial propulsion fleet. The Company's installed base of approximately 50,000 commercial and 30,000 military engines, including parked aircraft in addition to fleet in service, supports its aftermarket services business, which represents approximately 70 percent of revenue, reflecting the strength of customer demand across its business, and through FLIGHT DECK, its proprietary lean operating model, it prioritizes safety, quality, delivery and cost to drive focused execution and bridge strategy to results, focusing on delivering against its strategic priorities for today, ramping services and equipment, tomorrow, expanding capacity and capabilities, and the future, inventing the future of flight, with its global team building on more than a century of innovation and learning, and it serves customers in approximately 120 countries with manufacturing and service operations carried out at 70 facilities.
